trajectory_distinction_footnote: The FWR-trajectory closure measured here is a separate quantity from the prior natural-trajectory persistence sweep. The FWR trajectory starts from theta3 and repeatedly applies a forced expert-pair update. The natural reference follows canonical natural routing/training. Their closure times must not be collapsed into one number.

preregistered_comparisons.name: trajectory_window_direction
preregistered_comparisons.description: A longer forced-trajectory positive regime indicates persistence under repeated forced updates. A shorter forced-trajectory regime indicates earlier loss of the positive state under forced updating.
